meta.write: longer n=32 path past the B11c room time
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. You said longer. T passed the sketch’s room time. The field still did not climb. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B22_longer_readable
lemmas.statement: packet and blob stay readable on an n=32 run with T past the B11c room time
lemmas.why: T=0.384 > 0.375. Same box as B13 / B18. Not a bigger FFT. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B22a_longer_not_saving
lemmas.statement: a longer n=32 run produces mean or step c ≥ 8
lemmas.why: Past the sketch’s room time. Viscous means stay negative. Euler ~0. Step increments never reach 8.

lemmas.name: B22b_longer_not_ladder
lemmas.statement: a longer viscous run is a ladder for j_bar
lemmas.why: Packet 2.97 → 2.79. Blob 2.57 → 1.85. More time pulled the barycenter down, not up.

lemmas.name: B22c_longer_no_high_fill
lemmas.statement: a longer n=32 run fills resolved shells above the original triad
lemmas.why: Mass above j*+1 stays ~0. n=32 dealias still cannot host a fat j=4. Length did not buy a cascade.

lemmas.name: B22d_longer_clock_did_not_save
lemmas.statement: the longer run left CONC, and that is why X sat
lemmas.why: Still CONC the whole interval. Packet X falls 2.5 → 0.15 by viscosity. The clock did not flip.

lemmas.name: B22e_finer_open
lemmas.statement: a finer box (n>32) produces a saving climb
lemmas.why: Scored as B33. A bigger FFT is not continuation. n is a knob on the box. DNS leftover is B23e. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B22f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: lengthening T at n=32, or moving to n=64, is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. T is a knob on the check. n is a knob on the box. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8 into the equation.
